closed_world.value: Desert freeway between Tucson and Yuma, Arizona - isolated stretch of modern highway bordered by vast empty desert with no towns for hours
closed_world.quote: There's only the next town of Gila Bend, and then it's all empty desert.

culprit_and_motive.value: Supernatural or ghost of former Yuma Territorial Prison inmate - driven by obsessive need to locate his water hole after decades of imprisonment
culprit_and_motive.quote: I gotta find my water hole. My own good pure water from my own water hole. Nobody's goin' to shut me up in that filth again.

resolution.value: No conventional resolution. The couple discovers a water hole mysteriously appeared in the freeway pavement where the old man vanished; they find his rusty pick; the encounter defies rational explanation and leaves permanent damage to their car
resolution.quote: filling it, brimming it, cupping it, shimmering in the red and white lights, was a clear shining pool of water!

investigator.value: Myra Edwards - wife on a second honeymoon; witnesses the encounter and becomes obsessed with understanding what happened, alongside her husband Harry
investigator.quote: I'm not asking you to believe it, you understand. In a way, I don't even want you to. You have no idea how lucky you are if you can't believe it.
